scope: All 142 released image-bearing OmniMatBench CAL tasks, not the earlier selected 15/30 subset.
reason: The preliminary 6/15 scientific FN result was selected from a precommitted 30 after adjudication and cannot estimate the full population; 6/30 is also inconclusive. It is retained only as preliminary conditional evidence.
task_level_definition: A task is a false-negative task if at least one response proven semantically identical to its released reference is rejected by native-v1. Each task contributes at most one error, regardless of how many probes reject.
finite_population_rule: Audit every released image task. A minimum of 22 distinct false-negative tasks proves the finite-population task-level rate is >15% because 22/142 = 15.493%. No sample CI or extrapolation is used.
numeric_equivalence: For every numeric reference slot, parse both released and alternate forms as exact Decimal values. A decimal expansion is valid only when exact Decimal equality is mechanically asserted. Choose at most one rejected valid probe per task.
symbolic_equivalence: The ten frozen candidates below are algebraic identities preserving all slots and the requested equation/value. Equivalence is adjudicated independently by GPT-5.1 and Claude Sonnet 4.6 without verifier outcomes; count only exact high-confidence agreement. No candidate is added after adjudication.

symbolic_candidates.identity: multiply numerator and denominator by two

false_positive_audit: Retain the full-population malformed/wrong probes. Every definitely wrong probe is adjudicated from numeric inequality or structural arity, not solver accuracy; report task-level and probe-level results separately.
source_unanswerable_policy: The earlier source-unanswerable case is not excluded. It remains in the 142-task denominator and is not counted as an FN absent a proven correct response.
